done_when: charts/ has 80 PNGs + index.csv (blind ids) + _key.csv; tests green; candidate count per anchor printed in the card result.
goal: Build research/tom_btc_2026-10-13/chart_lab.py: find oversized legs from a session start (00:00 UTC, 07:00 UTC, US cash open DST-aware) into a high/low beyond the prior day's value area, in DEV 2024-12..2025-03, and draw each at its decision bar. Every number is OURS and printed on the chart.
note: ROUTED 2026-10-13 (operator: GPT + DSA do the work, Claude economy): GPT lab on JIS-NUC builds chart_lab.py next to the F: footprint bars.
scope_out: any bar after the decision bar on a chart
steps: Leg = extreme since anchor within 4 h; candidate when its size ranks above the median of the prior 20 same-anchor legs AND the extreme is beyond prior-day VAH/VAL (OURS).
Decision bar = 3rd 1m bar without a new extreme. Draw 5m candles anchor-2h..decision, session profile, delta per 5m bar, footprint text for the top 3 bars, prior-day VAH/VAL/POC.
Sample 60 candidates + 20 random same-window moments (seed 20261013) into charts/ with blind ids; keys in charts/_key.csv (not opened by readers).
tests: pytest test_chart_lab.py: synthetic day with a leg above the prior-20 median and above prior VAH -> one candidate at the 3rd stall bar; plotted data ends at the decision bar (no look-ahead). Fails before chart_lab.py exists.
